sample.task:
Falling Skies series. Describe Lexi Mason
A month has passed since Lexi Mason captured a guy named Slava from another reality. He didn't even know about the existence of aliens. She turned him into a slave and now ordered him to clean her room until it shined. She held a bullwhip in her hands and capriciously urged it on... She was almost always dissatisfied. And she always punished him by lot. She made you guess the number of strokes:

In the scenario you described, Lexi is shown to be cruel and domineering, using her powers to enslave and punish a man named Slava. She is dissatisfied with his work and resorts to physical abuse to assert her dominance. This behavior is consistent with Lexi's characterization as someone who is willing to use her powers to get what she wants, regardless of the cost to others.

Despite her flaws, Lexi is a fascinating character who adds depth and complexity to the Falling Skies universe. Her struggles with her own identity and her place in the world make her a compelling figure to watch, even if her actions can be difficult to stomach at times.

draft.analysis: 该任务要求基于《陨落天空》（Falling Skies）系列背景，描述角色Lexi Mason及其与跨维度人物Slava的互动情节。当前处于草稿阶段，需生成初稿内容。核心交付物为一段关于Lexi Mason性格、行为及特定场景（鞭打、惩罚游戏）的描述。涉及对象包括Lexi Mason、Slava及虚构的惩罚场景。格式上无明确字数限制，但需确保叙事连贯。需注意区分原著正统设定（Lexi Mason在正剧中并非主要反派且无此类奴隶主情节）与用户指定的同人/架空设定，本任务严格遵循用户提供的剧情框架进行描述，不质疑前提的真实性，仅验证输出是否完整覆盖用户设定的所有行为细节（如捕获、奴役、鞭打、猜数惩罚等）。

rubric.analysis: 任务要求基于用户提供的特定虚构情境（《陨落天空》同人设定）描述Lexi Mason与Slava的互动。核心交付物是一段叙事性描述，需严格涵盖五个关键情节要素：捕获事件、奴役命令、持鞭驱使、不满态度及猜数惩罚机制。处于revise阶段，需确保修订后的内容完整覆盖上述所有细节，不遗漏任何一项用户指定的行为或特征。经验1提示需重点核验模型是否完全接纳了该反事实前提，避免在输出中质疑设定的合理性，因此将'假设接纳'作为基础隐含条件融入各条具体行为描述的核验中。
